name: Finger Dash
summary:
**Remember running two fingers across a table like tiny legs? Now the table runs back.**

Finger Dash puts a toy robot on your real desk or kitchen table. Rest your hand on the pad in front of the track and your fingers do the running. Every tap lands on something solid, so it feels like playing with a real toy.

**Your hand is the controller**

- Tap two fingers to run, tap faster to go faster
- Slide your hand to change lanes
- Lift two fingers to jump, lay your palm flat to slide
- Finger gun to shoot, f
